description: This file is a C header (.h) file that declares the interface for exported functions related to a 'Sort List' object within a network management context. It provides function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the sort list object, which are intended to be used across the system.

methods.name: AnscCreateSortList
methods.description: Creates a sort list object for a given container, owner, and reserved handle.

methods.name: AnscSloCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Sort List Object, initialized with container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: AnscSloRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the specified Sort List Object.

methods.name: AnscSloEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrols any required sub-objects or dependencies into the Sort List Object.

methods.name: AnscSloInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Sort List Object, setting up internal state.
